notes.title: A Knights Adventure Version 2.5 is now LIVE.
notes.notes:
[h1][b]A Knights Adventure Version 2.5[/b][/h1]
Hello Adventurous Knights, 
 A Knights Adventure Version 2.5 update is now live! In this announcement we will be talking about what we have updated or changed in the game. This update is a halfway update for the major update that we talked about in a previous announcement. The new items and new features that have been added are listed below.



[h3][b]New Character Models[/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39659948/3316e5b5042b02987fd43106d0123fab510edde4.png[/img]


  We replaced all the old character models with new ones. There is now more variety in the enemies the knight will encounter on his adventure as he makes his way through the realms. The enemies will also differ in difficulty. The Knight and the his Companion got an upgrade also, their armours were getting pretty beat up from their adventure together. 


[h3][b]Lootable Chests[/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39659948/4fca717b8b97dd9840d5e0d2bb63a2e5e51a4b64.png[/img]
    
     We have added 3 variations of Lootable chests, each chest will contain some useful items the knight can use through out his adventure. Each chest will contain items equal to the rarity of the chest its self. Some chests may be harder to find then the others so leave no corner unsearched. 

[h3][b]Inventory System and Items[/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39659948/66d99f8ffea68f041d88199b421d2de6c16ae374.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39659948/a5a03e632d0a340969b40be6579a11b5ba54efd6.png[/img]

In this update we have have added quite a few more swords. We have also added a few shields. There is now an inventory system that allows the knight to equip the new swords and shields. The inventory system shows the stats of each weapon and shield when they are hovered over. We have also added some potions that have different affects such as healing, increasing the max health and the stamina max. These items are placed in chests that are scattered around the realm, so keep your eyes open.

notes.title: Major Update Progress
notes.notes:
Hello Adventurous Knights!




[previewyoutube=yGfbewMOlDo;full][/previewyoutube]
 This announcement is to show our current progress on the update. We have successfully added an inventory system as well as an equipment system. We added lootable chests!! There are three chests to loot, a Iron chest, Steel Chest, and a Gold Chest. Each level of chest will have different quality items or gear inside. For Example the basic iron chest will have basic items, the Steel Chest will have more rare Items and the Gold Chest will have the best items. There will be Chests scattered around the realms so keep an eye out for them! The long awaited use of stamina while sprinting is here! That's right, you now use up stamina while sprinting. We Changed out the Characters, this will allow us to give more variety in enemies and friendly NPCs. We have also added Potions! Some potions will recover your health, and some will increase your Max Health or Stamina. None of these features are in the current state of the game yet but will be when the update is finished. Depending on how long it takes us to finish polishing the features mentioned, we may do a half way point update before we start adding more features to give our Knights and Ladies of the realm a chance to try out the new swords, =).
     
      Once we finish up with the features we are currently working on, we plan to add different armours for the Knight to find through out his adventure. More Weapons, including More Swords, and adding Maces, Warhammers and of course Axes. We have added one shield so far,(Seen in the videoclip) we will be adding more, If we Publish a half way point update we will add more shields for the update. We also plan Adding more life to the realm, with more townsfolk and more variety of enemies to challenge our Valent Knight along his Adventure.
 Stay Adventurous!!

notes.title: Major Update In The Works
notes.notes:
Hello Knights,
 We are working on a Major update that may take several weeks to complete.  We want to inform everyone that while this Major update is being worked on there will be few if any minor Updates. Minor updates and tweaks will of course continue after the Major Update goes Live. Here is a list of what we will be working on in this update:

[list]
[*] Adding More Features.
[*] More Weapons And Armours (Also Adding Quality To Weapons/Armours such as Rusted, Worn, Etc).
[*] Adding Inventory/Equipment System. 
[*] More Townsfolk.
[*] Optimizations to further Help With Frame Rate Issues.
[*] More Lore For The Game World. 
[*] More Locations
[/list]
Stay Adventurous Fellow Knights!

notes.title: A Knights Adventure V.2 Is Now Live
notes.notes:
Hello Adventurous Knights!

Join us on this Glorious day as we celebrate a new update going Live! A Knights Adventure V.2 is now Live! The update includes some optimizations to help issues with frame rate, A brand new companion that will replace the old one.(Still acts a little weird though. We are Working on a solution for this). There is now a Target Lock-On system! The Knight can now Lock-On to a target. The stamina Recovery has been modified, Unlimited Sprint is still enabled but stamina recovery now pauses while sprinting. Some locations will have new NPC'S that will help bring more life to the game, more will be added in future updates! We hope this update brings out more enjoyment to the game as we move forward. 

Stay Adventurous Fellow Knights!

notes.notes:

[*] Stamina Recovery Now Pauses While Sprinting.

notes.title: Upcoming Update
notes.notes:
Hello Adventurous Knights,

A Knights AdventureV.2 update is on the way! We will post a update log when the update is live. We need more feedback! Our team have higher end PC's, so we might not experience or notice some issues our players have, for example the frame rate issues some players were having. Thanks to some reviews and the games discussion thread we became aware of them. The upcoming update will have some optimizations(More to come), because we were made aware of the frame rate issues, so in short your Feedback is most welcome and deeply appreciated.

notes.title: A Knights Adventure Demo V.1 is now live!
notes.notes:
Demo version of A Knights Adventure is now live, giving players a chance to try out the game. The demo version will have some areas and features locked. The demo version will include roughly one third of the full versions map. As we add more content and features to the full game we will add on to the demo as well, but the demo will still be limited to certain features and areas. 
Stay Adventurous!

notes.title: Update is Now LIVE
notes.notes:
Hello Adventurous Knights!
 The game has been updated! The contents of the update are listed in the patch notes. We hope this update brings more enjoyment to the game! More updates will be coming soon, we will Post a upcoming update announcement once we get closer to finishing the update. We aim to keep this window with in a week of the announcement, but unfortunately things happen, if this happens you will be updated about possible  delays. 
 Stay Adventurous!!

notes.title: Upcoming Update
notes.notes:
Hello Adventurous Knights,
 The upcoming update will be focused on the play area. That means more places to explore and of course more enemies to slay. 😁 There will be new locations and some old locations that have been moved around and remade. The added  playable area will be roughly about the same size as the playable area now, meaning the overall play area has more or less doubled in size. We hope you are all enjoying the game so far, and remember we want your feedback. Stay adventurous!
